Name: Mo's Mini Stardrop Flower
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds a growable, non edible version of the Stardrop Flower that is smol and cute. It is a universal love for all vanilla NPCs. It is not unlocked right away. If you want to know how it is unlocked read below:

[spoiler]You can buy it from the Hat Mouse.[/spoiler]

I am working on another mod that will add more mini flowers but it will be a while before it is finished so I'm publishing this one separate. Also this mod is required by more of my mods, and I didn't want people to have to download a huge mod for just one item.

The Mini Stardrop Flower is the purple flower seen in the first and third photos. The red flower seen is the Mini Prismatic Flower, which will be in the upcoming Mini Flowers mod.

Downloads.Description: Adds a growable, non edible version of the Stardrop Flower that is loved by everyone. See changelog for details. Delete old files before installing new one.
